title: Grade 8 Math — Tue, Jun 02
description: Squares & Square Roots — Day 2 of 5: Properties & patterns of squares
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A perfect square ending in 5 ends its tens-place pattern with ___.
questions.explanation: Squares of numbers ending in 5 always end in 25 (e.g. 15²=225, 25²=625).

questions.question: The number of zeros at the end of a perfect square is always ___.
questions.explanation: A perfect square has an even number of trailing zeros (e.g. 100, 400, 10000).

questions.question: Sum of first n odd numbers (1+3+5+…) equals ___.
Between 6² and 7² there are how many non-square numbers?
questions.explanation: Between n² and (n+1)² there are 2n numbers; 2×6 = 12.

questions.question: A perfect square can end in which digit?
questions.explanation: Squares can end in 0,1,4,5,6,9 — so 6 is possible (e.g. 16).

questions.question: If a number ends in 6, its square ends in ___.
Which cannot be a perfect square?
questions.explanation: 768 ends in 8 — no perfect square ends in 8.

questions.question: How many numbers lie between 10² and 11²?
questions.explanation: Between n² and (n+1)² there are 2n = 2×10 = 20 numbers.

questions.question: The square of a number ending in 1 ends in ___.
questions.explanation: 1² = 1, so squares of numbers ending in 1 end in 1.
